svg.title: Labelled group LTD cheque after a cap, tax, and a CPP disability offset
svg.desc: A made-up illustration. A formula of two-thirds of ten thousand dollars is cut to a five thousand dollar monthly cap, then reduced by tax if the employer pays the premium and by CPP disability if it is approved. Not a claim payment.
svg.text: The group cheque is not two-thirds of salary
Labelled sketch. Not your booklet. Not a quote. 24 Sep 2026.

g.text: Spendable if the benefit is taxable

svg.text: 2026 CPP disability maximum for a new benefit is $1,741.20. This sketch uses $1,200 so the bar is not the maximum.
There is no universal tax rate. Employer-paid LTD is usually taxable. Employee-paid LTD is usually not.
Personal coverage is the slice above the cap, owned by you, disclosed to the underwriter.
Assuris monthly income protection is the greater of $5,000 or 90% if a member insurer fails. It does not raise a thin cap.
